collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Sport Hatch 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Astra Sport Hatch 2005 to 2009 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Astra which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
